name: Elemental Ki (Mythic)
body:
Your ki attacks become more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Ki.

Benefits: Each point of burn you accept counts as 3 ki points for the purpose of activating ki powers and abilities.

At 7th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as lawful weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 16th level, your unarmed attacks are treated as adamantine weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.
